1. [1. Velora UI](https://adminlte.io/blog/shadcn-ui-block-libraries/#section-1)
2. [2. shadcn.io](https://adminlte.io/blog/shadcn-ui-block-libraries/#section-2)

17. [By design language](https://adminlte.io/blog/shadcn-ui-block-libraries/#section-17)

**These 13 libraries cover everything from massive marketplaces with 6,000+ blocks to specialized animation kits, official chart components, premium block sets, and design-system-grade Figma + React combos — plus one MIT registry that hands you a finished site along with its blocks.**

In 2026, shadcn/ui is no longer a single library — it’s an ecosystem. The official shadcn/ui project ships the core 50+ components and a growing set of blocks, but the real productivity gains come from third-party libraries that extend it: animated effects from Magic UI, Aceternity and Velora UI, marketing pages from Tailark, advanced primitives from Origin UI, AI patterns from Cult UI, and massive block marketplaces from shadcn.io and Shadcnblocks. Every library on this list either installs through the shadcn CLI (`npx shadcn add @library/component`) or copy-pastes directly into a shadcn project.

Every demo URL is opened and screenshotted before we republish this page.

Quick Picks

## 1. Velora UI
![Velora UI component catalog — 64 free MIT animated shadcn/ui blocks installable with one CLI command](https://adminlte.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/velora-ui-shadcn-block-library-light.jpg)

Free / open-source (MIT) — paid Pro tier announced

Best for: Animated blocks that arrive with a finished site to put them in

**Why we like it:** Every other library here hands you blocks and leaves the assembly to you. Velora ships 64 animated components _and_ the multi-page site they were designed for — home, pricing, blog, auth, changelog and 404 — with every component and the complete template under MIT, commercial use included. The catalog doubled in September 2026 and now covers navigation, forms, social proof and scroll — the categories most animation libraries reserve for their paid tier — and it is the one pick here where the published product is free in full rather than a preview of a paid tier.

Every component page publishes its gzipped size and dependency count, so you can pick by weight instead of by looks.

The catalog splits into backgrounds (aurora, retro grid, particles, meteors, flickering grid, light rays, lamp), text effects (typewriter, flip words, shimmer, word rotate, hyper text, number ticker), cards and layout (bento grid, spotlight, tilt, marquee, card stack, glare card, orbiting circles, dock), navigation (floating navbar, morphing menu, sticky banner), forms (vanish input, file drop, stepper), social proof (animated testimonials, tweet card, logo cloud), scroll (sticky scroll, container scroll, tracing beam, scroll velocity, parallax grid), effects (border beam, animated beam, blur fade) and device mockups (browser, iPhone, terminal). Each one installs as a standard shadcn registry item — `npx shadcn@latest add https://velora.colorlib.com/r/aurora-background.json` — and because the components import neither Radix nor Base UI, they drop into an existing shadcn project whichever primitive layer it already uses.

Two things separate it from the animation libraries further down. First, the receipts: each component’s docs page publishes its gzipped size and dependency count, and 33 of the 64 carry no runtime dependency at all — the rest use Motion and nothing else. Second, the components read your shadcn CSS variables instead of hardcoding hues, so every gradient, beam and glow re-brands from one token block, with ready-made presets on the themes page. A global `prefers-reduced-motion` switch covers the lot. Reach for it when you want motion polish without a mystery bundle — or when you would rather start from an assembled site than a components sandbox.

[Download](https://github.com/ColorlibHQ/velora-ui) [Preview](https://velora.colorlib.com/components)

## 4. 21st.dev
![21st.dev — community shadcn/ui marketplace with components and agent templates](https://adminlte.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/shadcn-blocks-03-21st-dev.jpg)

Free / community + paid registry tiers

Best for: Community-driven shadcn marketplace + AI agents

YC-backed. Different category than the curated marketplaces — wider variety, faster moving.

The Agents SDK adds session-isolated VMs, streaming, rate limits, and replay observability — a direction the rest of the shadcn block ecosystem isn’t pursuing yet. Y Combinator-backed.

[Download](https://21st.dev/) [Preview](https://21st.dev/)

## 5. Magic UI
![Magic UI — 150+ animated shadcn/ui components for design engineers](https://adminlte.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/shadcn-blocks-04-magic-ui.jpg)

React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Motion + shadcn/ui

Free / MIT + Pro tier

Best for: Animated components for design engineers

**Why we like it:** 150+ free animated components built with React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Motion. 20.8k GitHub stars. Designed specifically as a “perfect companion for shadcn/ui” — install via shadcn CLI, paste, ship.

**Editor’s Pick** — 20.8k GitHub stars and the most-loved free animated component library in the shadcn ecosystem. 150+ animated components and effects, all built on React, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Motion (formerly Framer Motion). Drop them into any shadcn/ui project — no rewiring required.

Magic UI is the canonical free animated component library for shadcn/ui. The 150+ components cover terminal animations, marquees, particle effects, kinetic text, animated lists, bento grids, ripples, and bordered beams — patterns that elevate landing pages and product surfaces. All components install via the shadcn CLI and ship as TypeScript source you own (not a runtime dependency). The Pro tier adds 50+ landing-page blocks and complete templates ($199 one-time) for teams that want pre-assembled pages instead of components.

[Download](https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui) [Preview](https://magicui.design/)

## 6. Aceternity UI
![Aceternity UI — motion-rich shadcn/ui blocks for landing pages](https://adminlte.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/shadcn-blocks-05-aceternity.jpg)

React + Next.js + Tailwind + Motion + shadcn/ui

Free + Pro all-access

Best for: Motion-rich blocks for SaaS landing pages

**Why we like it:** 200+ production-ready components, blocks, and templates with bento grids, parallax blocks, glare cards, canvas cards, glowing effects, hero sections — the most polished motion-rich shadcn block kit. Trusted by 120,000+ founders.

Aceternity UI is the flagship motion-rich block kit in the shadcn ecosystem. The 200+ components include hero sections, bento grids, parallax blocks, keyboard interactions, glowing effects, glare cards, canvas cards, text reveal cards, and feature sections — patterns that make a SaaS landing page feel “designed by an in-house team.” All copy/paste-friendly with no Framer Motion wrapper to fight. Free tier has the core components; Get All-Access ($249 one-time) unlocks the full library plus templates. Used in production by 120k+ developers including major YC startups.

[Download](https://ui.aceternity.com/pricing) [Preview](https://ui.aceternity.com/)

## 7. Cult UI
![Cult UI — 75+ animated shadcn/ui components and AI patterns](https://adminlte.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/shadcn-blocks-06-cult-ui.jpg)

React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + AI SDK

Free / MIT + Cult Pro

Best for: Animated components + AI SDK patterns

**Why we like it:** 3.8k GitHub stars. 75+ animated components plus 100+ AI SDK Agent patterns just-add-key.

Cult UI bridges two worlds: shadcn-compatible animated UI components and full-stack AI agent patterns. The free open-source library ships 75+ components covering Shift Cards (cards that show more detail on hover), Screen Capture, animated grids, motion text, and form patterns. The Cult Pro tier adds 100+ AI SDK Agent patterns — copy-paste workflows for OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude that you can drop into any Next.js + shadcn/ui app. Different niche than Magic UI: less landing-page eye-candy, more “AI-app glue.”

[Download](https://github.com/nolly-studio/cult-ui) [Preview](https://www.cult-ui.com/)

## 10. Origin UI (now COSS)
![Origin UI (now COSS) — modern UI component library compatible with shadcn projects](https://adminlte.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/shadcn-blocks-09-origin-ui.jpg)

React + Tailwind + Base UI / Radix

Free / MIT

Best for: Advanced primitives, AI-friendly

**Why we like it:** Origin UI rebranded to COSS in 2026 with 484 “particles” (advanced primitives) on top of Base UI — but the components remain Tailwind-based and copy/paste into any shadcn/ui project. Includes Accordion, Alert Dialog, Autocomplete, and other primitives shadcn/ui doesn’t ship.

Originally launched as Origin UI — a shadcn-compatible library of 400+ advanced primitives (timelines, rich dialogs, custom inputs) — the project rebranded to COSS in 2026 and shifted its base to Base UI (the Material team’s headless successor). Practically, the 484 “particles” remain Tailwind-based copy/paste components that drop into any shadcn/ui codebase: Accordion, Alert, Alert Dialog, Autocomplete, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, and many more — including patterns shadcn/ui doesn’t officially ship. 9.7k GitHub stars. Free, MIT-licensed.

[Download](https://github.com/origin-space/originui) [Preview](https://coss.com/ui)

## 11. ReUI
![ReUI — 1003+ shadcn/ui components with Base UI and Radix dual support](https://adminlte.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/shadcn-blocks-10-reui.jpg)

React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui + Base UI / Radix

Free / MIT + ReUI Pro

Best for: Largest free shadcn component collection

**Why we like it:** 2.9k GitHub stars. 1003+ free shadcn/ui components claiming to be “the largest free and open-source collection.” Dual library support (Base UI AND Radix UI primitives), Shadcn Create-compatible across all 5 styles and settings.

ReUI positions itself as “supercharge your shadcn/ui projects” with what it claims is the largest free open-source collection of shadcn/ui components on the internet — 1003+ components across forms, navigation, data display, feedback, and overlay categories. Two unique angles: dual library support (every component ships compatible versions for both Base UI and Radix UI primitives), and Shadcn Create compatibility across all 5 styles and settings without modification. ReUI Pro is on a waitlist with 40% launch discount for early adopters. Free MIT tier alone is the most ambitious free shadcn collection currently shipping.

[Download](https://github.com/keenthemes/reui) [Preview](https://reui.io/)

## 12. Skiper UI
![Skiper UI — un-common production-ready blocks for shadcn/ui](https://adminlte.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/shadcn-blocks-11-skiper-ui.jpg)

React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui

Freemium

Best for: Distinctive un-common components

**Why we like it:** “Un-common components for shadcn/ui” — Skiper UI ships components you won’t find in the canonical shadcn library or in Magic UI / Aceternity. Production-ready, install via `npx shadcn add @skiper-ui/skiper40` and similar one-liners.

Skiper UI’s pitch is right in the brand: un-common components. While Magic UI and Aceternity cover the canonical animated patterns (marquees, kinetic text, glowing borders), Skiper UI focuses on patterns those libraries skip — distinctive form interactions, niche layout primitives, and components that feel “right” in modern design systems but aren’t obvious. Each component installs via a numbered shadcn registry path (`npx shadcn add @skiper-ui/skiper40`). Free tier exposes the catalog; the Pro tier (Skiper Pro) unlocks the complete library plus assets.

[Download](https://skiper-ui.com/pricing) [Preview](https://skiper-ui.com/)

# Aceternity UI vs Magic UI vs shadcn/ui: Animated React Components in 2026
## TL;DR
All three use the **copy-paste philosophy** — you don't install a package, you copy components into your codebase. **Aceternity UI** specializes in stunning visual effects (3D cards, glowing beams, magnetic buttons, particle backgrounds) that make landing pages pop. **Magic UI** focuses on polished micro-interactions and marketing animations (animated beams, retro grids, neon gradients). **shadcn/ui** is the most practical — clean, accessible components with optional animation via Framer Motion, primarily built for application UIs. For marketing pages: Aceternity or Magic UI. For application UIs: shadcn/ui.

## Key Takeaways
- **All three are copy-paste** — no npm package to install, you own the code
- **Aceternity UI GitHub stars: ~28k** — the visual effects leader, heavily used in SaaS landing pages
- **Magic UI GitHub stars: ~15k** — growing fast, especially popular in developer-focused products
- **shadcn/ui GitHub stars: ~85k** — the most popular overall, used in enterprise React apps
- **All use Tailwind CSS** — `class-variance-authority` and `tailwind-merge` are standard dependencies
- **Framer Motion is the animation engine** for all three — `npm install framer-motion`
- **Aceternity uses Three.js for 3D effects** — heavier dependency but enables GPU-accelerated visuals

## Magic UI: Polished Micro-Interactions
### Installation Prerequisites
```bash
npm install framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge
```

## shadcn/ui: The Application Foundation
shadcn/ui provides 60+ accessible components (Dialog, Select, Combobox, Calendar, etc.) built on Radix UI primitives. Animation is available but secondary to function and accessibility.

### Installation
```bash
npx shadcn@latest init
npx shadcn@latest add button card dialog select
```

## Feature Comparison
| Feature | Aceternity UI | Magic UI | shadcn/ui |
|-|-|-|-|
| **Distribution model** | Copy-paste | Copy-paste | Copy-paste (CLI) |
| **Animation focus** | Heavy (3D, particles) | Medium (micro-interactions) | Light (transitions) |
| **Accessibility** | Basic | Basic | ✅ Radix UI |
| **Form components** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ Full suite |
| **Tailwind required** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Framer Motion** | Required | Required | Optional |
| **Three.js** | Some components | ❌ | ❌ |
| **Best for** | Landing pages | Marketing sites | Application UIs |
| **Component count** | 80+ | 50+ | 60+ |
| **TypeScript** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Dark mode** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **CLI installer** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ (`shadcn add`) |
| **GitHub stars** | 28k | 15k | 85k |

## When to Use Each

**Choose Magic UI if:**

## Methodology
Data sourced from GitHub repositories (star counts as of February 2026), component documentation, and community usage patterns. All code examples verified against current library versions.
